verdict.line: You lose if she catches you near a wall with E (Hookshot) and R (Hextech Ultimatum) both up; you win if you poke with Q while her E is down and cleanse her knockup with W.

brief.thesis: Camille has no gap-close or hard CC until she lands E (Hookshot) off a wall, and from level 6 she can chain that knockup into R (Hextech Ultimatum) to anchor you in place for her auto-attack burst. Gangplank's Q (Parrrley) outranges both her Q (Precision Protocol, 325 range) and her W (Tactical Sweep) cone, and W (Remove Scurvy) directly cleanses the knockup that starts her combo. At 49.6% over 2,294 games this is a genuine coin-flip decided by who tracks the other's cooldowns, not raw power.

theirWindow.when: Near a wall with E and R both up
theirWindow.what: She pulls to the wall and leaps back, knocking you up on landing, then from level 6 can follow with R to anchor you in the area for 475-range auto trades — expect this combo to start the moment her ultimate comes online.

yourWindow.what: With no gap-close she can't force anything, so step up and fire Q (Parrrley) at 625 range — well outside her 325-range Q and melee W cone — and let Grog-Soaked Blade poison tick on every auto you land.

powerCurve.note: Neither side has an all-in tool yet
Core items online, execution decides trades

start.why: Picked in 74.7% of games at 49.6% win rate — the sustain lets you hold trades through her early Q-into-W poke without losing the lane on tempo alone.

boots.why: Most-picked boots (52.3%) in this matchup; the flat damage reduction blunts the auto-attack chains she leans on in both her poke and her E/R all-in combo.

core.why: Mana sustain to spam Q (Parrrley) every 5 seconds without running dry, part of the highest-win-rate path at 54% over 326 games.
Armor penetration plus the execute threshold finishes targets already ticking down from Grog-Soaked Blade poison.
Crit scaling turns extended poke-and-poison trades into a damage lead rather than just chip damage.

situational.when: she starts building tanky to survive your poison DoT and poke
her Tactical Sweep healing and Adaptive Defenses shield keep her topped up through skirmishes
you're dying to her level 6/11 E-into-R all-in before you can disengage

runes.keystoneWhy: The DoT stacks with your poison passive to reward a poke-and-walk-away playstyle, which is exactly what you want against a champion whose only threat is a committed, wall-dependent all-in.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 90.8% of games at 50.1% win rate; Flash gives you an out from her E landing angle, and Ignite punishes her level 6-10 all-in window while cutting through the healing from Tactical Sweep.

playing.title: Poke whenever her E is down
playing.detail: Q (Parrrley) at 625 range outranges her Q (325) and her W cone (610), so every time her E (Hookshot) is on cooldown you should be auto-poking and stacking poison for free.

playing.title: Save W for her knockup
playing.detail: Hold Remove Scurvy through her poke so it's ready to cleanse the knockup from E's landing or the lock from R's anchor — using it early for the heal alone gives up your only answer to her combo.

playing.title: Track wall proximity, not just cooldown
playing.detail: E only works if she's within 800 range of a wall; if you're fighting in open lane with no wall behind you, her all-in threat drops even with E up.

playing.title: Respect the level 6 spike
playing.detail: The moment R (Hextech Ultimatum) comes online she can chain E's knockup into a 475-range anchor for extended auto trades — play a step safer right as she hits 6.

playing.title: Ignite her commitment, not her poke
playing.detail: Save Ignite for the moment she actually lands E or R rather than trading it for lane poke — it both secures the kill and denies the sustain from her W.

playing.title: Fight through her shield with DoT
playing.detail: Adaptive Defenses shields her against the next hit of whichever damage type she takes, so sustained poison and Deathfire Touch ticks outvalue trying to one-shot through the shield.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, and summoner picks above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the cooldown numbers and ability behavior are from the live game files, and the tactical reading of when to trade or hold W is our own analysis, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Dodge Camile’s (W) while hitting her with your [E] when she closes in with (E). Purchase Doran’s Blade to increase your sustain.
